track: Native CUDA/PTX/actual optimized library evidence and connected implementation audit
definition: Supported scoped observation means one saved empirical/source/native check supports the stated subcase. Model-level consistency means exercised numerical implementation choices can reproduce correct values; it does not validate hardware timing/private structure. Implementation contradictions require profile-to-code repair, not hardware-value rejection. Untested entries received a negative sufficiency check and retain their engineering baseline.

rows.name: Accumulation order
